headline: THE 2.60 FAST RUNTIME REPRODUCES: MEDIAN 33.29 TPS AGAINST A HISTORICAL 33.31

artifact.note: closure sha is over relative path + size for every file in the tree; the campaign's own physical EBPW of 2.596957 counts only the weight-bearing suffixes, so this all-files figure is DIFFERENT BY CONSTRUCTION and is not a competing density claim.

executable.note: a cargo EXAMPLE, not a shipped binary. It was not built at all before this lane.

invocation.why_raw: ARM B of the S027 factorial. Under the template this body emits ' <think>' and halts at decode_steps=0, so a TIMED run is only possible on the raw arm. That is a finding, not a convenience.

historical_comparison.MISATTRIBUTION_CORRECTED: S027 §0A lists 33.31, 34.15 and 34.24 as three historical measurements OF THE 2.60 BODY. They are three DIFFERENT BODIES in the same receipt: clean-2.60 = 33.3136, sealed-3.14 = 34.1488, variantA-2.98 = 34.2431. Only 33.31 is the 2.60 body.

CAPABILITY_SCORE.value: 0/43 through the production chat template; UNKNOWN on a corrected template
CAPABILITY_SCORE.why_reported_here: S027 §15: raw TPS from incapable output is not performance. This receipt therefore refuses to state an ACCEPTED_TPS.

ACCEPTED_TPS_absent_reason: cannot be computed until the S027 §2 factorial establishes a template under which this body produces scoreable output. RAW_TPS alone is not performance.

contention.owner: ModelLake fill -- OPERATOR PRIORITISED, not paused for this measurement
contention.evidence: the historical receipt recorded a quiesce_check_before with pausable_io SIGSTOPped; this run did NOT pause it. The tail shows it: max 57.22 ms/token = 17.48 TPS. The MEDIAN is unaffected at 30.04 ms, which is why the band still reproduces.

claim_boundary: SINGLE-STREAM RAW GPU rate only. Not aggregate, not accepted, not end-to-end wall.
STEADY_DECODE_WALL_NS_PER_TOKEN ran 31.15-48.13 ms across the same reps -- the wall carries host wait that the fill contends. Only the GPU-side median reproduces cleanly.
One prompt, one shape, greedy, 60 new tokens. Not a workload characterization.
An earlier 28-token run of the SAME binary and body read 37.48 ms/token. That was a SHORT-RUN ARTIFACT with warmup dominating, not a regression -- recorded so the number is not later quoted as one.
